Container.Name: accounts-balance-tracker
Container.Overview: Self-hosted tracker of your accounts balances over time: bank, savings, investment, pension, crypto, cash and loans. Record each account's balance whenever you want and see the total and its evolution in charts. CSV import/export, optional login with one-time codes. Data in a SQLite file in /data.

Config.Name: Default currency
Config.Description: Currency for new accounts and for the total of all currencies (ISO 4217 code: EUR, USD, GBP...)

Config.Name: Exchange-rate service
Config.Description: Exchange-rate service (Frankfurter API or a self-hosted copy of it). Only currencies and dates are sent, never amounts

Config.Name: Login user
Config.Description: User for the login screen. Set it together with the password; leave both empty for no login

Config.Name: Login password
Config.Description: Password for the login screen. Changing it logs everyone out

Config.Name: Login one-time code (OTP)
Config.Description: true = also ask for a code from an authenticator app. The first login shows a QR code to add it; to show a new one, delete .totp_secret in the Data folder

Config.Name: Several users
Config.Description: true = several users by invitation, each with their own encrypted database. The login user and password above are then the admin's (go to /admin to invite people), and the one-time code is always asked

Config.Name: Account days
Config.Description: Several users only: days a new account lasts; then its data is deleted and the user blocked. The admin can extend it. 0 = no expiry

Config.Name: Max users
Config.Description: Several users only: most users that can sign up

Config.Name: Max database size (MB)
Config.Description: Several users only: most size of each user's database, in MB

Config.Name: Country of last login
Config.Description: Several users only: true = download DB-IP's free country database once a month, to show the country of each user's last login. The IP is never sent to another service

Config.Name: Exchange-rate requests a day
Config.Description: Several users only: most requests a day to the exchange-rate service, for all users together (then the stored rates are used)

Config.Name: API docs
Config.Description: true = interactive API docs at /docs and /redoc, and the schema at /openapi.json (behind the login). Off by default

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: IPs or CIDR ranges of the reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For header is trusted (the real client IP). Default: local and Docker networks. Set your proxy's IP to be stricter
